subject: Signals and Systems
chapters: Chapter 6: Frequency Response of Continuous and Discrete Time Systems

questions.text: Explain Signal Classifications: Continuous-Time (CT) vs Discrete-Time (DT), Periodic vs Aperiodic, Even vs Odd, Energy vs Power signals ($E = \int_{-\infty}^\infty |x(t)|^2 dt, P = \lim_{T \to \infty} \frac{1}{T} \int_{-T/2}^{T/2} |x(t)|^2 dt$). Explain Unit Step, Unit Impulse, and Unit Ramp functions.

Explain Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) Systems and Impulse Response ($h(t)$). Derive Convolution Integral ($y(t) = x(t) * h(t) = \int_{-\infty}^\infty x(\tau) h(t - \tau) d\tau$) and Convolution Sum. Evaluate convolution of two rectangular pulses graphically and analytically.
Explain Continuous-Time Fourier Series (CTFS: Trigonometric and Exponential forms). State Dirichlet's conditions. Find exponential Fourier series coefficients for a periodic square wave.

Explain Continuous-Time Fourier Transform (CTFT) and Inverse CTFT. State and prove CTFT Properties: Linearity, Time Shifting, Frequency Shifting (Modulation), Time Scaling, Duality, Differentiation, and Parseval's Energy Theorem.

Explain Laplace Transform and Region of Convergence (ROC). State properties of ROC. Find Laplace Transform and ROC of $x(t) = e^{-at} u(t) - e^{-bt} u(-t)$. Explain transfer function $H(s) = \frac{Y(s)}{X(s)}$ and pole-zero plot for system stability and causality.
